verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms PostHog's session replay lets PMs watch DVR-style recordings with synced DevTools panel (posthog-docs-26, posthog-docs-29, posthog-gh-8), but nothing in the pack mentions input masking, privacy controls, or sensitive-data redaction being applied by default. missing for 10: any documentation of input masking/privacy defaults, evidence of what is masked or how, and confirmation it's on by default rather than opt-in.
